content.text: Safety At REC, safety is our top priority and it should be yours as well. Do you know how to keep yourself and your family safe around a downed power line or how to safely use a generator during a power outage? Find the answers and other important safety information. It could save your life. Learn more Winter Storm Fern (Jan. 2026) - Stay warm. If you don't have an alternate, non-electric heat source, know the locations of the closest warming centers. Shop Now: Storm Preparedness Find the items you need to prepare for a major storm all in one easy-to-use online storefront. Get started today! Shop Here Reliability REC works hard every day to provide its members with safe, reliable electricity. We regularly plan projects to upgrade power lines. Upgrades can more than double the capacity compared with the old lines. They also improve service reliability. Trees are one of the major causes of power outages in areas with overhead utility lines. We work tirelessly to clear branches near and on top of overhead lines to provide safe and reliable service. Learn More REC STORIES Spring is one of the best times of year to work on home efficiency.
